description: Hookify plugin - User-configurable hooks from .local.md files

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse.py"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "hookify: hook script not found, skipping: $f" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec python3 "$f"
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/posttooluse.py"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "hookify: hook script not found, skipping: $f" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec python3 "$f"
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stop.py"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "hookify: hook script not found, skipping: $f" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec python3 "$f"
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/userpromptsubmit.py"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "hookify: hook script not found, skipping: $f" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec python3 "$f"
